subject: Offer calibration: Billing Ops Sr. Manager + FP&A Analyst (REQ-1843 / REQ-1844)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Park <jamie@talenthq.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0000
Subject: Offer calibration: Billing Ops Sr. Manager + FP&A Analyst (REQ-1843 / REQ-1844)

Team —

Following the final onsite loop, Talent (Jamie) and I recommend two hires for the finance & billing organization: a Billing Ops Sr. Manager (REQ-1843) to lead invoice platform migrations and a mid-level FP&A Analyst (REQ-1844) focused on billing analytics and pricing telemetry. Both candidates are mission-critical to the Q3 platform stabilization and billing accuracy initiative.

Quick ask: please review the proposed comp bands and confirm approval for the recommended offers below by end of day tomorrow. The hiring managers need to issue the offers to hit a planned start date of 2026-08-10 for the Sr. Manager.

Proposed offers (summary):
- Billing Ops Sr. Manager (Renee Cole, external candidate) — base: $180,000; target bonus: 12% (OTD); proposed sign-on: $15,000 (relocation not requested). Current band for Senior Manager is $155,000–170,000 (band B3). This is a +$10–25k deviation high of band.
- FP&A Analyst — base: $105,000; target bonus: 8%; sign-on: $5,000. Band for Analyst role: $95,000–110,000 (band A2).

Attachments: comp_band_review_REQ-1843-1844.xlsx (band comparison and comp history), offer_draft_RENEE_Cole_v1.pdf (wording + PTO), requisition_REQ-1843_REQ-1844.pdf (budget codes included).

Rationale for Renee: 8+ years billing ops at high-growth SaaS (led 2 migrations, cross-functional with product/infra), strong candidate sourced via Talent HQ. She has a competing offer in market that is verbally at $175k base + $10k sign-on. We believe $180k + $15k sign-on buys experience and reduces ramp risk. Cost center: FIN-BILL-3203 (budgeted within Q3 hiring plan but requires approval for band exception).

Please reply with Approve / Counter / Decline and any thresholds for sign-on or band adjustments. If approved, I will route to People Ops for extension and DocuSign.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Offer calibration: Billing Ops Sr. Manager + FP&A Analyst (REQ-1843 / REQ-1844)

Ben —

Thanks for the write-up. Before I can approve a band exception of this size for the Sr. Manager, please confirm the following:
1) Which headcount bucket will absorb the incremental cost (is this within the FY26 billing ops hire plan or an ad-hoc increase)?
2) Is there an expected ROI or SLA delta tied to Renee's role we can quantify for the Finance leadership scorecard?
3) Any objections from Hiring Manager on a reduced sign-on (e.g., $10k)? If sign-on will exceed $15k, we need concurrence from Head of People and an explanation for sign-on above $15k.

Also cc'ing Neha for compensation calibration thoughts. If you can send the comp-band spreadsheet highlighted with the proposed deviation and line item budget code, that will speed approvals.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Finance & Operations (Interim CFO)
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 13:20:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Offer calibration: Billing Ops Sr. Manager + FP&A Analyst (REQ-1843 / REQ-1844)

Laura —

Thanks — answers inline:
1) Headcount funding: Cost center FIN-BILL-3203 (product billing backlog initiative). This role was included in Q3 hiring plan but at a lower midpoint. The incremental is about $15k–20k on comp run-rate this fiscal year and is accomodated by a combination of hiring slack in other ops roles and a small reallocation from contractor spend (see attached comp_band_review with highlighted lines).
2) ROI / SLA impact: Renee's prioritization includes reducing invoice failure rate by 40% over 3 months post-hire through automation and process changes. Conservative estimate: $120–180k annualized recovered revenue and reduced remediation headcount (1.0 FTE avoided). I summarized the expected impact on the finance scorecard in the attached doc (greenlight link in related_links).
3) Hiring manager preference: Manager prefers to keep sign-on at market and secure the candidate — Jamie confirms counteroffer at $175k. If we reduce sign-on to $10k, we risk losing Renee and potentially a 6–8 week slippage in project timeline.

I've updated the comp_band_review file with highlighted cells and included the budget transfer notes. If it helps, we can cap the sign-on with a 12-month clawback clause (repayment if leaving within 12 months).

Ben

Subject: Re: Offer calibration: Billing Ops Sr. Manager + FP&A Analyst (REQ-1843 / REQ-1844)

Ben / Laura —

I reviewed the spreadsheet and the projected recovered revenue metric. From an FP&A / RevOps perspective I'm willing to approve the base at $180k given the ramp risk and immediate project impact, but I want to reduce the sign-on to $12,000 and add the 12-month clawback Ben suggested. That keeps overall comp within a more defensible envelope while improving our negotiation position.

Conditions: 
- Sign-on capped at $12k with clawback (12 months prorated).
- Mark the hiring as an approved exception with the comp exception code EXC-FIN-2026-07 and log in the comp deviation tracker (see greenlight link).
- People Ops approval required if sign-on > $12k (per policy).

Ben: please update the offer draft to reflect base $180k, sign-on $12k (clawback clause), and include the EXC-FIN-2026-07 code in your requisition. I'll confirm with Finance team to ensure the small run-rate increase is absorbed by the quarter.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, FP&A & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
